verdict.line: You lose if you facetank a full Q-into-W combo with Riposte down; you win if you bait her E or catch a missed Q and punish the cooldown.

brief.thesis: Riven's entire trade pattern is Q (Broken Wings) chaining into W (Ki Burst) for the stun, and every hit in that chain is a basic attack Fiora's W (Riposte, 750 range) can parry. Since Fiora regenerates health per hit landed via her passive (Duelist), a parried combo doesn't just deny damage — it flips the exchange into a heal-up for you. The 54.8% win rate over 677 games and Fiora's solo-kill edge both come from this: the matchup rewards patience on W over greedy Q (Lunge) trades.

theirWindow.when: Q and W both off cooldown, full combo ready
theirWindow.what: She can double or triple-dash Q (13s cooldown, 3 reactivations, third hit knocks back) straight into W (Ki Burst stun, 11-7s cooldown) for a full stun-lock trade. Do not extend the fight here unless your Riposte is also up to parry the follow-up auto.

yourWindow.what: Valor (10-6s cooldown) is her only block and gap-close/escape. With it down she can't dodge or disengage, so double-Lunge with Q (600 range, free second dash) and hold W for anything she throws back.

start.why: Run by 90.9% of Fioras in this matchup at 52.8% win rate — the lifesteal and AD stack with Duelist to win the early poke war against her Q pokes.

boots.why: 85.2% pick rate at 53.9% win rate — flat physical damage reduction blunts every auto in her Q-chain and the empowered Runic Blade hits.

core.why: Lets Lunge (Q) cleave the wave while you threaten trades, and the omnivamp keeps Duelist sustain rolling.
Highest-sample core path (61.5% win rate, 161 games) — the damage and move speed proc punishes her the moment E (Valor) goes down.
Damage-over-time conversion smooths out her burst windows so a landed Q-W combo doesn't delete your HP bar in one trade.

situational.when: you're ahead and want to force all-ins before her item spikes
the lane turns into a long sustain war and you want extra healing
she builds ahead and you need the spell shield plus magic resist to survive dives

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through extended trades and duels, matching the OP.GG read to watch her own Conqueror stacks — whoever sustains the fight longer wins it. Master-tier players instead run Press the Attack (9,519 games) for burst on the parry follow-up; that suits players who want to end trades fast rather than grind out extended skirmishes.

summoners.why: Flash + Ignite is the standard pick (73.7% pick rate) and the Ignite punishes her all-in sustain post-combo. Exhaust + Flash runs a higher 57.8% win rate over a smaller sample — take it if you want a hard answer to her all-in windows rather than a kill-secure tool.

playing.title: Hold W for the stun auto
playing.detail: Riposte parries her next basic attack, so save it for the auto that follows her W (Ki Burst) stun rather than throwing it on cooldown.

playing.title: Trade only when her E is down
playing.detail: Valor (10-6s cooldown) blocks incoming damage and closes distance — engage with Q (Lunge) right after she's spent it.

playing.title: Punish whiffed Q chains
playing.detail: Broken Wings is a single 13s cooldown for all three charges — if she misses the combo, double-Lunge in for free damage before it's back up.

playing.title: Open trades with Riposte armed
playing.detail: Activating W before she commits deters her Q-ins, since any auto she throws gets reflected as magic damage.

playing.title: Respect the ultimate spike
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile grants bonus AD and range plus a ranged Wind Slash — once she's 6+, don't sit in minion waves at low HP near her max range.

playing.title: Chase resets with E
playing.detail: Burst of Speed's move speed gain on landed hits lets you stick to her after she uses Valor to disengage.

playing.title: Save R to isolate, not to open
playing.detail: Blade Waltz deals reduced damage on repeated hits to the same target, so use it once she's split from her team, not as your opening damage.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, rune pages, and every win rate or sample size above are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.19.1); the combo timing and trade-pattern reasoning are this brief's own tactical judgement.

stats.opponentTip: Keep an eye out on Riven’s Conqueror stacks while fighting her. Block any of her skills with [W] to prevent her dishing out her full combo and therefore giving you the upper hand.
